name: 23435 · Suffolk, VA
findings: ZIP 23435 (Suffolk) has 120 nonprofit organizations. 48 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 39 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (32% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 23435 (Suffolk) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.text: 11 social and fraternal organizations here list membership, compared with about 3 in similar places of this size.
